description: Illustrative decision-card record for a private decisions channel backed by an append-only local ledger. Not an executable schema; field names follow the reference design. All values are fictional.

card.title: Send the October newsletter (Website A)
card.body:
Short summary of what will be sent, to whom, and why now.
A: Send this version
B: Hold until next week
My recommendation (A): the content is already reviewed.

risk_tiers.internal_decision: Button plus a confirmation dialog (choosing an option)
risk_tiers.high_external: Form with an important-action reminder (public deploy, submission, deletion)

form.text_box: Optional instruction for this item only. A new recipient or an extra external action needs its own card.
rules: send_this_version with text in the box is blocked with a hint
revise_then_show_me creates a new revision; the old revision stops working

creation_checks: owner must be a registered coordinator or CTO mailbox
content must be marked public and pass a scrub; confidential markers are refused
deploy, submit and delete require high_external
an external action cannot be labelled internal
payment, password and account-creation actions are refused
only the decisions or debug channel
a case whose approval was used cannot take a new action
identical content cannot reset the expiry
a new external target gets a default grant in mode 'confirm'

ledger_events.note: channel and message reference, used for the overdue link
single use, immediately before the separately authorized action
